data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017, net ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2015 & prior) reduced by GBP 10.1m. This was mainly due to favourable claims experience in Director and Officers, Marine Liability and Marine Cargo resulting in reserve releases in line with standard actuarial techniques. This was offset by net ultimate claims increases in International Construction (adverse attritional and large loss development on Starr coverholder business), Professional Indemnity (large losses reported in the year; Appleby, Shepherd Building Group, Precision and Pitcher Partners) and General Liability (adverse attritional development).

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the gross claims outstanding balance was GBP 506.799m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded net favourable development on prior underwriting years (2015 & prior) with net ultimate claims reducing by GBP 10.1m; using the published gross claims development table (gross triangle) yields an estimated gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 6.66m (c.1.3% of opening gross reserves). The release reflected favourable experience in Director & Officers, Marine Liability and Marine Cargo, partially offset by adverse development in International Construction, Professional Indemnity (several large reported losses) and General Liability.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding GBP 506,799k). Prior-year movement: no single explicit GROSS 'movement in prior years' figure was printed; narrative quoted a NET release of GBP 10.1m. I calculated a gross prior-year movement (-GBP 6.661m release) from the published gross claims development table (triangle) on page 39. Net and gross figures differ (net release GBP 10.1m quoted). Values derived from OCR of scanned pages and manual transcription of triangle - minor digit uncertainty possible. Some named losses are reported without explicit years or quantification.
